description: A chunky cartoon ice-cream van. A short rounded bonnet at the front with two round pale yellow headlights and a simple dark grille, a cab with a large windshield, one side window per door and a light grey side mirror on each door at window height; behind the cab a tall boxy van body with rounded top edges; on the left flank a large rectangular serving window with a small sloped awning above it (diagonal pink and cream stripes) and a narrow light grey counter shelf on small brackets below it; on the roof a big ice-cream cone sign (a tan waffle cone with a pink scoop on top) standing upright on a small light grey base. Full-width light grey front and rear bumpers and four wheels with dark tyres and light grey hubs. Lower body pastel pink, upper body and roof cream, windows pale blue-grey, bumpers and hubs light grey, tyres dark charcoal.
proportions: at a width of 2.0 m, the body is 4.73 m long and 3.0 m tall from the ground to the roof (length : width : height = 2.37 : 1 : 1.5); the cone sign rises 1.7 m above the roof, so the overall height is 4.7 m (2.35 times the width); the awning and the counter shelf stick out about 0.4 m from the left flank; the wheels are 0.89 m in diameter, the wheelbase 3.1 m (0.66 of the length).
sides: the serving window, the striped awning above it and the counter shelf below it are on the LEFT flank only; the right flank is a plain two-tone wall with no window, no awning and no shelf. Everything else (the mirrors, the wheels, the cone sign on the roof centre line) is symmetric.
